guards.what: min/max read fresh per pass instead of carried from the last pass that wrote them
splitNumber rounded half to even (FPC Round)
NICE_MODE_ROUND in place of NICE_MODE_MIN for the first interval (the audit named A1, which does not bite)
both fixed: the rounded interval used for minNice/maxNice (the audit named C6, which does not bite)
the fix flags swapped together with the reversed values
a flat extent opened both ways although max is fixed
no increaseInterval after the 50th failed pass
the final (outerBounds) pixel span in place of the option rect
device pixels (x1.5, PPI 144) in place of CSS pixels

cases.name: NR-min0
cases.note: min fixed, span/seg 1.5: NICE_MODE_MIN starts at 1, which covers ([0, 4.7]); NICE_MODE_ROUND would start at 2

cases.name: NR-neither
cases.note: neither end fixed: interval 2 covers; NICE_MODE_ROUND would start at 3

cases.name: RIV
cases.note: both fixed, t0 = t1 = 0.85, p 3: minNice from the UNROUNDED interval is -2.186 (rounded: -2.187)

cases.name: RIV-small
cases.note: both fixed at px 5, p 1: niceExtent [-0.6, 0.6] (rounded interval: [-0.7, 0.7])

cases.name: Z0-scale
cases.note: scale:true target touching zero: an odd spare segment is centred, not all put above zero

cases.name: D7-logmin3
cases.note: log target fixed at 3: the low end stays 3, not 10^log10(3)

cases.name: E1
cases.note: y0 plain: y1 and y2 align to it

cases.name: E2
cases.note: every axis asks: the first (y0) is the reference

cases.name: E3
cases.note: the lowest-index plain axis (y1) is the reference

cases.name: E4
cases.note: an axis with an interval never aligns and becomes the reference

cases.name: E6
cases.note: horizontal: x1 aligns to x0, px is the option rect width

cases.name: E7
cases.note: the only other x axis is a category axis: nothing aligns (axes [])

cases.name: E8
cases.note: a time axis is never a reference: nothing aligns (axes [])

cases.name: E10
cases.note: dataZoom pins both ends (zoomFixMM): unit level only, no end-to-end (audit SS4)

cases.name: PX-255
cases.note: both ends fixed: the precision reads the pixel span

cases.name: OB-74
cases.note: final px 74 but the align pass saw the option rect (280): p 3, not 2

cases.name: SV-lo
cases.note: a written startValue below the data fixes the min end (C10): the min-fixed branch

cases.name: SV-hi
cases.note: a written startValue above the data fixes the max end (C10): the max-fixed branch
